claims: The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon is on March 15, 2026.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon is a 13.1-mile point-to-point course.
The course starts at Washington Avenue in Brooklyn near the Brooklyn Museum.
The course goes through Prospect Park.
The course goes along Flatbush Avenue.
The course crosses the East River via the Brooklyn Bridge.
The course traverses the FDR Drive.
The course passes near the Lower East Side.
The course goes through Times Square.
The race finishes in Central Park at 72nd Street and West Drive.
The first wave starts at 7 a.m.
The course includes steep early climbs over the bridge.
The course includes rolling hills in Central Park.
Eight aid stations with water and Gatorade are available.
A gel station is available at mile 8.2.
Street closures in Brooklyn and Manhattan run from 12:00 a.m. to 11:30 a.m.
Street closures affect areas like Eastern Parkway.
Restrictions near the finish last into the afternoon.
Participants and spectators can use the NYRR app for live tracking.
